name: Allied Green Ammonia Project, Gove Peninsula, Northern Territory
description: Total project cost US$6.8 billion stated by proponent; TOPSOE process licence and ammonia engineering (Oct 2023/May 2024); Plug Power 3 GW electrolyser purchase and BEDP (Jan 2025); SPG Steiner two 40,000 t cryogenic ammonia tanks (July 2024); Air Liquide Japan cryogenic nitrogen generator BEDP; ABB Australia micro-grid MOU; port and seawater intake infrastructure at Gove. CSIRO HyResource page read, reviewed by proponent April 2026.

capacities.basis: Capacity as stated on the cited page.
